dataCheck.authzHint: A successful sign-in only means the credential is authenticated; whether a protected endpoint can be called still depends on the engine’s authorization policy. When the credential is sent and refused, the cell says authenticated but not authorized.
dataCheck.listUsersHint: Fetch the user list and show the email of the first few; each email can sign in once.
dataCheck.loginHint: Press Sign in on a row: how to sign in is the data layer's business (a host-held credential gets a token, otherwise the server sets a cookie).
dataCheck.loginTestHint: These endpoints exist only on the development instance; a production engine does not register them. Press Sign in on a user row: how to sign in is the data layer's business.
dataCheck.noEmailForLogin: This account has no email; test sign-in accepts email only
dataCheck.scaffoldHint: The two public calls run for real; sign in through “Sign-in (test mode)” before pressing the protected pair, which explain any refusal by its code. Every request carries the current language and theme.
dataCheck.statesHint: The four stages of one fetch: not started, in progress, done, failed — shown with the public GET.
dataCheck.title: API check
